item.title: New Website
item.description: Welcome to the Chen lab website! We’re excited to get working on getting the lab started: buying equipment, recruiting people to join the team, and pushing back the boundaries of cancer science. Please enjoy the site and let us know if you have any comments or find any bugs! We hope to update this space regularly with lab events and announcements.
